rows.label: State tax on non-owner-occupied homes over $1 million
rows.value: $2.50 per $500 of assessed value above $1,000,000, from the tax year beginning July 1, 2026
rows.note: Statewide tax (R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 44-72) on residential property not occupied by the owner 183+ days a year; billed by the State. Threshold is indexed from 2027.

sections.title: Rhode Island real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate conveyance tax
rows.value: $3.75 per $500 of the sales price (raised from $2.30 on October 1, 2025)
rows.note: Equivalent to 0.75%. Applies to the full price when consideration exceeds $100.

source.title: City of Cranston, RI: State Notice of Real Estate Conveyance Tax Rate Change

rows.label: Additional tier on residential sales over $800,000
rows.value: Extra $3.75 per $500 on the portion of a residential sale price above $800,000
rows.note: Tier 2 applies to residential property only, on the part of the price above $800,000, in addition to the Tier 1 tax on the whole price.
